main.description: Fresh crawl + ingest of a SocialContract (constitution / international treaty / social norm). Sources: UN Treaty Collection, Constitute Project. Writes vertex_contracts_social_contract directly to Hyperdrive (ADR-0036). Law full-text corpus (statute/article) is out of scope — delegated to houbun.etzhayyim.com (ADR-0052).

docId.description: Source-native identifier (e.g. UN Treaty Registration Number, Constitute country code). Omit for source-wide delta.

since.description: ISO 8601 date — only ingest records updated after this cutoff (delta mode)

limit.description: Max records to ingest in one call (default 100, max 1000)
